title: Coding sandboxes and Pi tools
summary:
Coding sandboxes, Pi MCP setup, larger inline-media chats and model evals joined a rebuilt community page.

Alpha E2B Linux sandboxes were added through the API and Polli CLI. They can be created, inspected and reached over SSH, with sandbox time paid from a Pollinations wallet in advance. Polli also gained native setup for hosted MCP servers in Pi. Smaller follow-ups clarified the Machines permission, fixed chat-session exits and improved a harness request example.

Chat completions now accept JSON requests up to 100 MiB when they contain supported inline media. Large image, video and file data URIs are stored as media and replaced with URLs before reaching a provider; each offloaded URI is capped at 20 MiB, and model support for URL inputs still varies. API documentation was regenerated as the media support expanded.

A Quest contribution added text-model rankings and past runs to Model Monitor, including community models. The first evaluation runner uses fresh versions of the Alice in Wonderland, AIW+ and Bowls puzzles; scores include confidence intervals so close results are not presented as clear wins. Weekly runs are configured for Mondays, with an on-demand option.

daily.title: Alpha coding sandboxes
daily.text: Create Linux sandboxes with Polli, inspect their logs and connect over SSH. Sandbox time is paid from your Pollinations wallet in advance. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Pi gets MCP setup
daily.text: Use `polli mcp install pi --all` to configure hosted MCP servers in Pi while preserving your other server settings. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Larger inline-media chats
daily.text: Send chat requests up to 100 MiB with supported inline image, video or file data URIs. Large media is converted to URLs for the provider; which URL types work depends on the model. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Text models get evals
daily.text: Compare text models, including community models, in Model Monitor’s new Evals tab. Rankings show past runs and confidence intervals, starting with puzzle-based evaluations. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Find your community route
daily.text: The rebuilt Community page brings together app listings, model and agent publishing requests, GitHub contributions and Discord. Open votes now reflect reactions on GitHub issues. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).
